decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude. By using cards like Leyline Binding to lock down threats and generating value with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck aims to outvalue its opponent and eventually close out the game with a powerful threat like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all required colors of mana.

A deck focused on aggressive gameplay, utilizing a combination of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, disruption through cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, and burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fury to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Blood Moon is included to disrupt non-basic land strategies, while Terminate deals with problematic creatures. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional ways to protect and strengthen your creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with quick, efficient threats and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a presence on the board with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The main goal is to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible while controlling and disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds consistency to the mana base and allows for additional aggression. The variety of land fetch cards and multi-colored spells provide versatility in the deck's strategy, making it adaptable to different matchups. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed and disruption.

The main idea of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to combine aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats, along with some graveyard synergies with Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and finish the game quickly with efficient creatures and removal spells.

The deck focuses on maximizing graveyard interaction by cycling through the deck quickly with cards like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries. By casting Living End, the deck is able to put all of its creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield, often overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupting their board state. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Negation to protect its game plan. Ultimately, the goal is to create a powerful board presence quickly and win the game through a massive swing in creatures.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Combo - Living End deck is to quickly cycle through your deck, cascade into Living End to bring back all your powerful creatures from the graveyard, and overwhelm your opponent with a board full of threats. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into Living End, combined with cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Architect of Will, you can set up explosive turns and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation to protect your combo and keep control of the game.

The deck focuses on assembling a combination of creatures that can generate value and create a toolbox of options through Chord of Calling and Collected Company. The key strategy involves utilizing cards like Gilded Goose and Cauldron Familiar alongside Witch's Oven to generate advantage and create a loop. Chatterfang, Squirrel General and Academy Manufactor provide additional value and synergy within the deck. The inclusion of cards like Delighted Halfling and Samwise Gamgee adds versatility and flexibility to the combo strategy, allowing for a variety of options in different matchups.

This deck focuses on using various creatures as a toolbox to assemble a combo win condition. It includes creatures with abilities that can be searched for and brought onto the battlefield using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The deck also includes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate advantage and control the board. The key strategy is to efficiently tutor for and utilize creatures to create a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip huge damage-dealing creatures like Kaldra Compleat and Gingerbrute. Stoneforge Mystic helps search for key pieces, while Inkmoth Nexus provides an alternative win condition. The deck also features disruption elements like Spell Pierce and Esper Sentinel to protect the combo. Urza's Saga helps find important artifacts, and The Reality Chip can provide card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with efficient and explosive plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and controlling the game through disruption and resource management. It aims to generate value through artifact synergies such as Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek, as well as Urza's ability to generate mana and card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole for additional disruption, while Stoneforge Mystic helps to tutor up key artifacts. With a mix of control elements and powerful artifact synergies, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 setting.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions and board state through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. It also includes powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation for threats and card advantage. The deck utilizes a mix of control elements, card advantage, and powerful threats to dominate the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and The One Ring offer additional control options to maintain dominance on the battlefield.

This deck focuses on quickly setting up an aggressive board presence through the use of cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to flood the battlefield with powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Mystical Dispute and Subtlety to control the opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creature and spellcasting while leveraging the cascade mechanic to generate additional value and maintain tempo.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand and board state while applying pressure through efficient creatures. Cards like Thoughtseize, Grief, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help to strip the opponent's resources, while Undying Malice and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allow for recurring threats. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. Blood Moon can be a powerful disruption tool against multicolor decks, and Dauthi Voidwalker provides additional graveyard hate. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using various counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also utilizes powerful Planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation to gain advantage. The deck also includes the Kaheera companion to provide additional support. The mana base is carefully constructed to allow for consistent access to the colors needed for the deck's spells and abilities. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and out-value the opponent to secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to use creatures with sacrifice abilities and toolbox creatures to generate value and combo off with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Chord of Calling. The deck focuses on tutoring for specific creatures with Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, while also utilizing sacrifice outlets like Yawgmoth to generate card advantage and drain the opponent with cards like Zulaport Cutthroat. The deck also includes ramp cards like Arboreal Grazer and Khalni Garden to accelerate the strategy.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently to bring out powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck can generate large amounts of mana for explosive plays. The deck also includes utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion to provide additional benefits. Additionally, Karn, the Great Creator can help shut down opposing strategies while Urza's Saga provides additional versatility. Overall, this deck aims to assemble its pieces quickly to overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.
